## Overview

Captured API Explorer overview headed **Transfers API v4**. It presents a cross-product endpoint catalog for payouts to transfer instruments, third-party sends for users with business bank accounts, grant-offer payouts, transaction queries, and outstanding grant balances. Versions 1 and 2 are stated to be deprecated; the page directs new implementations to the latest version. This is an overview and route catalog, not an endpoint request/response schema. See [[adyen]], [[adyen-platforms]], [[adyen-payouts]], [[adyen-business-accounts]], and [[adyen-capital]].

## Key takeaways

- Each Transfers API request must use an API key in the `X-API-Key` header. The page distinguishes generation in Customer Area for Platforms or Marketplace setup from Balance Platform Customer Area for Issuing. It also says an additional API-credential role is needed and transfers must be enabled for the **source balance account**, with Adyen-contact setup of roles and permissions. It does not name the role or establish that any account is enabled.
- Endpoint versioning uses a `vXX` URL suffix. The shown test base is `https://balanceplatform-api-test.adyen.com/btl/v4`; the separate going-live passage requires a live Customer Area key and identifies `https://balanceplatform-api-live.adyen.com/btl/v4`. These are documented environments, not evidence of current eligibility or a live operation.
- The catalog routes to GET/POST grants, GET transactions, GET/POST transfers, transfer approval/cancellation/returns, and POST cashouts. A listed method and short summary do not establish required fields, approval conditions, response codes, status transitions, settlement or bank receipt. Follow the exact endpoint reference and relevant product guide for those claims.

quotes.text: Versions 1 and 2 of the Transfers API are deprecated. If you are just starting your implementation, use the latest version.
quotes.location: raw line 7, under # Transfers API v4

quotes.text: The Transfers API provides endpoints that you can use to transfer funds, whether when paying out to a transfer instrument for [marketplaces](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces/payout-to-users/on-demand-payouts) or [platforms](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/payout-to-users/on-demand-payouts), [sending funds to third parties](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/business-accounts/send-receive-funds) for users with business bank accounts, or to [request a payout for a grant offer](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/capital). The API also supports use cases for [getting transactions for business bank accounts](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/business-accounts/transactions-api) and getting [outstanding balances](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/capital#get-balances) for one or more grants on your platform.
quotes.location: raw line 9, under # Transfers API v4

quotes.text: Each request to the Transfers API must be signed with an API key. Generate an API key in your Customer Area if you have a [platform setup](https://docs.adyen.com/platforms/manage-access/api-credentials-web-service/#generate-api-key) or [marketplace setup](https://docs.adyen.com/marketplaces/manage-access/api-credentials-web-service/#generate-api-key).

To use the Transfers API, you need an additional role for your API credential. Transfers must also be enabled for the source balance account. Your Adyen contact will set up the roles and permissions for you.

When going live, generate an API key in your [live Customer Area](https://ca-live.adyen.com/ca/) if you have an Adyen for Platforms integration or [live Balance Platform Customer Area](https://balanceplatform-live.adyen.com/balanceplatform/) if you have an Adyen Issuing integration. You can then use the API key to send requests to `https://balanceplatform-api-live.adyen.com/btl/v4`.
